front-completion-p06-bulb-flange-front15.label: CL201023 HS1 bulb three-ear stamped locating flange
front-completion-p06-bulb-flange-front15.details: Original locating flange from three actual supplier poses. Rolled outer lip, depressed annulus and three individually authored different ears. Finite estimated gauge, bore and bends. No capsule, terminals, filament, socket attachment/weld or optical prescription. Partial bulb child only; clean metallic appearance hypothesis. v1 gray-only diagnostic rejected for flat ears; v2 explicit smooth axial bend and transverse curl, both bounded estimates, no exact bend radius claim.
